data.narrative:
Voltra is a seed-stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Alexander Stratmoen and Aryan Afrouzi. The company has raised $1.8M to date. The Climate & Energy frontier-tech sector includes 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers, among them Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis applied one applicable method. Stage-Progression triangulation uses the $1.8M total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $4.5M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable: while 8 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 satisfy narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), making a narrow peer median unreliable. A broad all-sector median would introduce material distortion given Voltra's specialized subsector positioning.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.8M to $5.2M, centered at $4.5M. This single-method result carries meaningful uncertainty. The primary limitation is the absence of sufficiently tight peer comparables at seed stage in Climate & Energy, preventing confidence-building triangulation. Key unknowns include Voltra's burn rate, technical maturity, and IP defensibility relative to the identified peer set. A broader dataset or follow-on financing signal would refine this estimate materially.
